images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: NEW default illustration for a Dragon Database form card.
Input image 1 role: STYLE AND ANATOMY REFERENCE ONLY, never an edit target. Use the reference's sophisticated colorful painterly fantasy-storybook finish, precise scales and expressive mature dragon forms. Completely redesign its composition and background, changing the palette as specified. Do not copy the crowded landscape, roaring pose or storm action.
Primary request: a powerful majestic mature creature, visually striking and clearly readable at small card size, with a different pose and atmosphere from the reference.
Composition/framing: landscape 5:3. One complete creature dominates 65–80% of the frame, with a crisp detailed central silhouette. Keep the whole head, body, tail, and every defining wing or fin clearly inside the frame with breathing room around every extremity. Compose for a shallow landscape card crop. Protect the central head and body from clutter and overlap.
Style/medium: vivid sophisticated hand-painted fantasy storybook illustration, textured gouache and watercolor with fine ink/scaled detail on the creature. Sharply described creature against a simple softly painted atmospheric background with strongly reduced detail, contrast and visual noise. Preserve visible brushwork and expressive illustration shapes; no photorealism or 3D. Strong light/dark and warm/cool separation between creature and background.
Constraints: strictly follow the stated anatomy. One creature only, no people or other creatures. No text, lettering, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, frames, interface or collage. No gore. No fire, breath attacks, turbulent storms or lightning. Background remains an understated atmospheric wash, with no intricate buildings or highly detailed foliage competing with the creature.
Scene/backdrop: a softly lit dusty-rose sandstone cavern, broad simple curved stone silhouettes with very little detail, muted pink and lilac mist and gentle warm light. This soft rose-pink background provides clear complementary separation from the emerald creature; no busy forest or elaborate ruins.
Subject: a thick muscular EMERALD-GREEN armored WYRM, a long continuous dragon-headed serpent with absolutely NO legs, NO arms, NO hands, NO feet, NO wings and NO fins. Its whole heavy serpentine body forms a broad elegant coiled S across the foreground, with its tapering tail clearly visible. A large horned head rises watchfully above the coils, CLOSED MOUTH or a very subtle low snarl, narrow attentive eyes, dark jade armor ridges and warm highlights along emerald scales. Powerful and ancient, alert rather than loudly roaring. Keep its uninterrupted limbless silhouette immediately readable.
Palette: saturated emerald and deep jade subject against softly luminous dusty rose sandstone, pale pink and lilac mist. A vibrant green-pink pairing, not blue ocean colors.

refinement.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1: edit target, the newly generated golden/coral Amphiptere illustration.
Change only composition/framing: pull back the view by about 20–25% so the COMPLETE creature, both full wing tips, every feather extremity, horns and tail fit within the landscape 5:3 frame, with a clear 7–10% band of dark indigo background between every extremity and the image edge. The upper-left wing must no longer touch or cross the top or left image edge. The right wing must also have clear breathing room. Keep the creature still dominant, roughly 70% of frame width; this is an illustrated form card.
Keep unchanged: richly detailed painterly fantasy storybook medium, the creature's vivid GOLDEN and CORAL colors, its CLOSED MOUTH and calm confident head, long continuous S-curving serpentine scaled body, exactly TWO broad feathered wings, NO legs, NO separate arms, NO feet or hands. Preserve the same anatomy and powerful adult proportions. Keep the dark desaturated indigo twilight backdrop, softly painted minimal sea horizon and moon glow, quiet low-detail background and warm gold rim lighting.
Extend the softly painted indigo background naturally as needed for the wider composition. No additional creatures, text, signatures, logos, watermarks, frames, interface, fire, gore, photograph or 3D.
